### linearElasticity

Solving the equations of linear elasticity with lattice Boltzmann methods. Two
families of cases are provided, both of them validated against manufactured
solutions:

* `quasistationary` solves stationary linear elasticity with a multiple
  relaxation time scheme on a `D2Q8` descriptor. The simulation is iterated
  until the displacement field no longer changes, which makes these cases the
  right starting point for static load problems.
* `elastodynamics` solves the time dependent Navier--Cauchy equation with the
  vectorial lattice Boltzmann method (`vectorLBM`), where every cell carries a
  `VECTOR` of `D2Q4` populations. These cases resolve wave propagation through
  the solid.

Within each family the cases differ only in the boundary condition they
exercise: a periodic domain without any boundary, a prescribed displacement
(Dirichlet), a prescribed traction (Neumann), and a combination of the latter
two. Every case ships a `run.sh` that repeats the simulation over a range of
resolutions and reports the experimental order of convergence.
